verdict.rationale: Grafana's Explore view supports ad-hoc queries with split-view comparison across time ranges and data sources (grafana-gh-1, grafana-gh-4). The docs name LogQL as Loki's query language for label-based filtering (grafana-docs-15), and trace search and metric querying are documented via Tempo and Mimir (grafana-docs-4, grafana-docs-34). One user complains that documentation for pulling data is thin (grafana-comm-3). missing for 10: named and documented query languages for metrics and traces (only LogQL is explicitly evidenced), in-depth query-language reference documentation, independent hands-on corroboration of ad-hoc query workflows.
